review_text: I am using this app from the very beginning of its release at that time we didn't had any cash point and we need to go to the banks for cashin but now we can bind our accounts with multiple bank acc and load esewa through most of the bank acc. Not only this but Ticket bookings, Delivery services, Bill payments, topups and many more are being provided to us to make things much easier. There were some bugs and other issues but the developers fixed it as soon as they got reported about it. Love it.
